document: R6-SUPPLY-01. The machine-readable advisory policy for every npm workspace in this repository. tools/ci/check_npm_advisories.py is the gate: it runs `npm audit --omit=dev --json` per workspace, requires an UNEXPIRED exception for every advisory the audit reports, fails when an exception is past its expiry, fails when an exception no longer corresponds to a live advisory (a risk we no longer carry must not stay accepted on paper), and fails when a NEW advisory appears with no exception at all. Prose in a review document is not an exception; only a row in this file is.

workspaces.note: Canonical local stack orchestration (Alchemy graph declaration + wrangler consistency + native S3 half). Runs credential-free: stack/no-cloud-guard.mjs refuses any lane that could reach a real Cloudflare account.

history.action: alchemy is ALREADY on the newest published line (2.0.0-beta.72, dist-tags latest AND next, published 2026-08-12); the only semver-greater versions on the registry are April 2026 pipeline/CLI test tags, which is why `npm audit fix --force` proposed the four-months-older 2.0.0-pipeline-v2-test. Upgrading the direct dependency was therefore not available as a remedy. Every advisory was instead remediated at the transitive package with pinned npm `overrides` (see stack/package.json), which resolved all 14 to 0 without touching the emitted graph.
history.graph_equality: node cli.mjs graph is BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after the override set; node cli.mjs check-wrangler PASS; stack suite 68/68.
